SRC-404:R002.text: Make Russian the intended default reply language for this installation.

SRC-404:R003.text: Change the authoritative configuration to `reply_language: ru`.

SRC-404:R004.text: Ensure all generated host instructions derive from the same selected contract.

SRC-404:R005.text: Do not duplicate language rules independently in Claude, Freebuff, OpenCode, Gemini or other host adapters.

SRC-404:R006.text: Detect contradictions between the effective host instruction and SAIPEN language configuration.

SRC-404:R007.text: Report effective language and its authoritative source through machine-readable diagnostics.

SRC-404:R008.text: Preserve the actual higher-priority instruction hierarchy.

SRC-404:R009.text: Never silently treat an explicitly conflicting language instruction as compatible.

SRC-404:R010.text: Keep protocol fields, code, paths, logs and machine-readable evidence unchanged.

SRC-404:R011.text: Do not merely edit STYLE.md and globally replace STATE markers.

SRC-404:R012.text: A new user request must not disappear because unrelated work was active.

SRC-404:R013.text: Never preempt foreign-owned work or bypass authority restrictions.

SRC-404:R014.text: Do not invent a deadlock if the agent is simply executing SCOUT.

SRC-404:R015.text: Unchanged authenticated policy plus ordinary observation update must not revoke an otherwise valid standing grant.

SRC-404:R016.text: Conversely, a genuine policy or authority change must still invalidate the grant.

SRC-404:R017.text: Do not weaken the authorization boundary to make the test pass.

SRC-404:R018.text: Do not claim a performance root cause from unrelated SAIPEN logs.

SRC-404:R019.text: Any optimization must preserve unit orders, legitimate AI behavior and deterministic simulation requirements.

SRC-404:R020.text: Do not mutate BZDECOMP merely because this SAIPEN handoff mentions it.

SRC-404:R021.text: Russian language selected without contradictory host instructions.

SRC-404:R022.text: STYLE migration does not corrupt active project checkpoints.

SRC-404:R023.text: Existing jobs survive a host restart.

SRC-404:R024.text: New requests are durably captured and correctly queued or executed.

SRC-404:R025.text: Active work is not silently overwritten.

SRC-404:R027.text: Standing grants survive harmless observation updates.

SRC-404:R028.text: Real authority-policy changes still invalidate grants.

SRC-404:R029.text: Malformed collect hypotheses fail closed without exceptions.

SRC-404:R031.text: Canonical validation passes before final closure.

SRC-404:R032.text: No unauthorized Git, release or foreign-project mutations.

SRC-404:R033.text: Ordinary tests must not disturb Windows foreground focus, keyboard, mouse or active desktop windows.

SRC-404:R034.text: Do not substitute a green test summary for a completed canonical lifecycle.
